title: Bruandwo Pty Limited - acquisition of Taverner Hotel Group Pty Limited

body_sections.Market definition: The ACCC primarily considered the impact of the acquisition on the market for retail packaged liquor for off-premises consumption in local areas in South Australia and Victoria.
body_sections.Competition analysis: The ACCC considered that the acquisition was unlikely to result in a substantial lessening of competition in the relevant markets due to the existence of other competitors that would act as a competitive constraint on the merged entity.
